messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Heads-up: Helix wants a joint co-sell POC next week. Main asks: SSO (SAML) setup, KMS/HSM requirements, IP allowlist for staging, and a pilot price for ~100k tokens/day for 2 weeks. Who can own infra and partner handoff?

Priya (Sales AE): I can handle pricing/comms. Need a ballpark by EOD so we can confirm commitment. Are we doing reserved pool or hosted overflow?

Alex (Solutions Eng): Ill own infra/ops for the pilot. Suggestion: small dedicated pool (2x A10s) + hosted overflow. Gives predictable latency and a safety net. Will estimate costs and post a breakout.

Alex (Solutions Eng): Quick performance note: with prefix caching and dynamic batching we're likely to hit low tens of ms per token on chat workloads. Peak concurrency will drive sizing more than average token rate.

Alex (Solutions Eng): ```
# rough pilot sizing notes
expected: 100k tokens/day (~1.16 tps avg)
assume peak 30-60 tps depending on user patterns
recommend: 2x A10 dedicated + autoscale burst to hosted
KV/prefix cache expected to reduce token cost ~25-35%
```

Jordan (Partner Eng): Helix will host the UI in their VPC and needs SAML metadata + a staging tenant. Also asks for three outbound IPs to add to their allowlist. Ill paste CIDRs shortly. Whats the tenant creation handoff flow?

Alex (Solutions Eng): Handoff steps: 1) create staging tenant in Console, 2) configure SAML metadata, 3) set entitlements (quota/models), 4) generate scoped API key (short-lived). Example create command: 
```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/tenants \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <admin>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"helix-staging","quota":100000}'
```
We then export SAML metadata XML and share the test key via secure channel.

Nate (Security): Security checklist: they requested HSM-backed keys and audit logs. We support AWS KMS with CloudHSM and customer-managed KMS for Private deployments. For hosted with HSM well need to confirm SLA and key residency. Ill send the security questionnaire and flag any blockers.

Priya (Sales AE): If we need reserved billing for the 2-week window, can legal do a quick addendum? Also offering a pilot discount makes the deal much easier. Recommend 25% off reserved pilot rates and hosted overflow at list. Thoughts?

Maya (Partnerships): Owners: Alex = infra/ops, Jordan = partner handoff/tenant testing, Priya = pricing/commercial, Nate = sec questionnaire. Ill own coordination/runbook. Target: tenant + SAML metadata shared by Tue (48h).

Alex (Solutions Eng): Creating tenant now and setting a default quota. Will post console link when done.

deploy-bot: tenant created "helix-staging-1765" by Alex (Solutions Eng). Console: https://console.redwood.ai/tenants/t-helix-staging-1765 :rocket:

Jordan (Partner Eng): Helix CIDRs for allowlist: 203.0.113.12/32, 198.51.100.45/32, 198.51.100.46/32. They'll open firewall window Wed 09:00-12:00 PT.

Nate (Security): Security questionnaire: https://docs.redwood.ai/sec/pilot-questionnaire. Immediate notes: HSM-backed customer keys require Private deployment or BYO-HSM integration; hosted KMS acceptable if they accept managed key custody. Ill call out data residency options and SOC2 artifacts in the questionnaire. ETA for completed questionnaire: EOD today.

Priya (Sales AE): Pricing calc incoming after Alex posts numeric cost. Will draft a short MSA addendum for a 2-week reserved pilot with a trial discount.

Maya (Partnerships): Great, thanks team. Action items summarized: Alex -> finalize cost numbers + console tenant; Jordan -> coordinate allowlist & SAML exchange; Nate -> complete sec questionnaire; Priya -> draft pilot pricing and short addendum. Follow-up sync tomorrow 10:00 PT.
